title: 3.1.0.3 + 3.2.0.1 No Pump (Dana RS) Pairing possible
body:
The problem here is that in the pairing process the pump goes into communication according to the pairing codes,
the arrows appear but then the process stops. 

The whole thing happens reliably 12 times in a row. It is a DANA RS V3 from 03/2023. 
Another older RS in working well.

Log attached.
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1698424097983.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13191320/AndroidAPS_LOG_1698424097983.log.zip)

@MilosKozak 

Anyway, thank you very much for your efforts

Issue detected/solved, it was a display resolution problem.

The pairing dialogue doesn't get scrollable when showing more content than the current device resolution allows, so the user isn't able to reach the "cancel / ok" buttons (or can't even guess they are there).
Implementing scrollable diaglogue, fix-binding exit/confirmation-buttons to the visible bottom part or allocate the Enter-Key / bottom right key of the virtual keyboard to a 'send' command could be helpful enhancements.

This is a "small device/screen"-issue, like Jelly/oldphone users.

Workaround was "connecting pump via big-screen phone and import saved settings to Jelly" 

(Screen was taken from a working phone though, just as a reference)
